page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; marginal quotation marks („) at the left margin of each line act as continuation marks, not notes; signature at foot.

main_text.p: externè quidem præscribebat, sed cordi inscribere non potuit; quia Spiritûs S. efficaciâ destituebatur. Undè lex illa tota Ministerium mortis & condemnationis; Evangelium verò Ministerium Spiritûs ac justitiæ, 2 Cor. iii, 8,9. nuncupatur. 2. Demonstratur totius hujus Legis Moralitas & perpetuitas, ex formâ legis, quam Christus proponit Matth. xxii, 37. Diliges Deum tuum ex toto corde tuo, &c. Proximum sicut te ipsum: quæ summa totius Legis Moralis est, à quâ nemo quartum Præceptum nisi absurdè exclusérit: quemadmodùm nec à maledictione, quæ Legi annectitur, [Gal. iii. Maledictus qui non manserit in omnibus, quæ scripta sunt. 3. Ex Jac. ii, 10. Quisquis totam legem servaverit, offenderit autem in uno, omnibus tenetur: quod pronunciatum Apostolus Christianis, ad quos scribit, & quos Fratres appellat, applicat; Cujusque veritas constare nequit, nisi & illud sub N. T. de quarti Præcepti transgressione locum habeat. Alioquin enim si in hoc Præcepto nihil Morale sit, qui illud non servârit is non esset reus violatę legis

page.notes: Marginal quotation marks at left are printed line-starts, not notes. Several words in the italic and roman text are printed irregularly and some passages are blurred; the bracket "[Gal." and "sit," near the line ends are doubtful. The final word "legis" is partly obscured by the catchword "gis" at the foot, which is printed as a catchword and is "gis". Uncertain: "Matth.xxii" and "Gal. iii" numerals.
